en_title: Arc Raiders' 2.0 Update and 'Spider-Man' Grappling Hook Drive Player Count to Reach 7-Month High
cn_title: 《蜘蛛侠》《Arc Raiders》人数创七月新高
subtitle: 像蜘蛛侠一样荡起来
opus_summary: 《Arc Raiders》2.0更新带来雪山地图与抓钩，配合免费周末，推动Steam同时在线人数升至166,670人，创七个月新高。专属PvE模式测试也将随后展开。

paragraphs.en: The new Arc Raiders 2.0 update has triggered a seven-month high for its concurrent player count on Steam as fans show up for its "Spider-Man" grappling hook, a new map, a free weekend, and more.
paragraphs.cn: 《Arc Raiders》2.0更新带来了能让玩家像「蜘蛛侠」一样摆荡的抓钩、新地图和免费周末等内容，吸引玩家纷纷回归，推动Steam同时在线人数创下七个月新高。

paragraphs.en: Embark's once-viral extraction experience has had a rough few months. As the studio slowed down updates and vowed to rework its divisive Expedition prestige system , Arc Raiders players have largely left it behind, hoping to one day return to Speranza should more enticing updates arrive.
paragraphs.cn: Embark这款曾经爆红的撤离游戏，过去几个月过得并不顺利。工作室放缓了更新节奏，并承诺重做饱受争议的远征（Expedition）重置成长系统。与此同时，《Arc Raiders》的玩家大多已离开游戏，盼着哪天有更具吸引力的更新，再重返Speranza。

paragraphs.en: After reaching an all-time peak of nearly 500,000 players on Steam (via SteamDB ), it's consistently struggled to reach more than 35,000 players on PC since July. It was a fall from grace that's left fans missing the honeymoon phase, but the Frozen Trail update, which launched two days ago, October 8, across PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S, has almost immediately brought back some of that hype.
paragraphs.cn: SteamDB数据显示，游戏在Steam上的同时在线人数曾达到近500,000人的历史峰值，但自7月以来，PC端人数一直难以突破35,000人。如此明显的下滑，让玩家怀念起游戏最初的蜜月期。不过，两天前，也就是10月8日登陆PC、PS5和XBOX Series的Frozen Trail更新，几乎立刻让游戏找回了几分昔日的热度。

paragraphs.en: In September, Arc Raiders reached a player count low of just 10,000 on Steam. As of the publication of this story, 166,670 people are logged onto Arc Raiders on the PC platform alone, and it looks like it could keep climbing. It's a number Embark hasn't hit since early April, and although it's too soon to tell if these are the kind of results needed to give it a proper second wind, it does mark the first time the game has achieved a notable spike since December 2025.
paragraphs.cn: 9月，《Arc Raiders》在Steam上的同时在线人数一度跌至仅10,000人。截至本文发布，仅PC端就有166,670人正在游玩，而且这个数字似乎还可能继续攀升。Embark自4月初以来就没再见过这样的人数。现在还无法判断，这样的表现是否足以让游戏真正重振旗鼓，但这确实是游戏自2025年12月以来首次出现显著的人数增长。

paragraphs.en: It's all thanks to Frozen Trail and the free weekend that helped usher it in. The update, which brought the first substantial changes Arc Raiders has received since Riven Tides in April , introduced a collection of game-changing content. Its crown jewel is Pendola Pass, a snowy mountainous region located beyond Raiders' usual home in the Rust Belt. New buildings to loot and shoot through would surely be enough to bring fans back, but it's really just the tip of the iceberg.
paragraphs.cn: 这一切都要归功于Frozen Trail，以及伴随更新开启的免费周末。这是《Arc Raiders》自4月Riven Tides更新以来首次迎来大幅改动，加入了一系列足以改变玩法的内容。其中最亮眼的是Pendola Pass：这片白雪覆盖的山区位于突袭者平日活动的锈带（Rust Belt）之外。新的建筑可供搜刮和交火，光是这些想必就足以吸引玩家回归，但它们其实只是冰山一角。

paragraphs.en: New Arc threats like the Bully, Skulker, and Hydra have shaken up combat encounters. The Tether Launcher, which can tie enemies to objects against their will, and the Grappling Hook have given players new tools to experiment with. That aforementioned free weekend, meanwhile, which runs from October 8 – 12, has allowed even newcomers to check out how Embark has changed Arc Raiders for the better. Individually, these are updates that would pique the interest of even the most casual fan, but the only reason so many are installing the game again is because of how these tweaks add new toys to the sandbox.
paragraphs.cn: 恶霸鲁尼、Skulker和Hydra等新的Arc威胁，让战斗有了新的变化。系索发射器（Tether Launcher）可以强行将敌人与物体绑在一起，它和抓钩都为玩家提供了可供尝试的新工具。前面提到的免费周末从10月8日持续至12日，让新玩家也能亲自看看Embark如何改善了《Arc Raiders》。这些更新单独拿出来，都能引起哪怕只是偶尔游玩的玩家的兴趣。但这么多人重新安装游戏，归根结底还是因为这些改动为沙盒增添了新的玩具。

paragraphs.en: "I was not a believer," one popular post on Reddit said . "This is one of the best updates ever in a video game."
paragraphs.cn: Reddit上一则热门帖文写道：「我之前是不信的。这是电子游戏史上最棒的更新之一。」

paragraphs.en: The same post continued, first praising Frozen Trail's scale. They admitted to being a lapsed Arc Raiders fan, explaining that the mix of Embark's new elements not only got them to return but also has them looking forward to what's next.
paragraphs.cn: 这位发帖者接着先称赞了Frozen Trail的规模。他坦言自己曾是《Arc Raiders》的玩家，后来离开了游戏，并解释说，Embark加入的这些新元素不仅让他回归，也让他开始期待后续内容。

paragraphs.en: "I absolutely loved Arc Raiders for its first 6 months but I got frustrated with it since they announced the twice a year update," they said. "I quit playing, said that these devs don’t know what they’re doing, they fumbled, etc. I know it probably won’t reach the popularity and number of players it had in December but that doesn’t matter to me, what matters to me is that I was flat out wrong about these devs and their ability to update the game. What they did here is special and I just wanted to come out and admit I was wrong and give them their flowers. I’m now extremely excited for the future of this game."
paragraphs.cn: 他写道：「《Arc Raiders》推出后的前6个月，我真的特别喜欢它，但自从他们宣布一年更新两次后，我就开始感到失望。我不再玩了，还说这些开发者根本不知道自己在做什么，把事情搞砸了之类的。我知道游戏可能无法再达到12月时的热度和玩家人数，但这对我来说不重要。重要的是，我对这些开发者以及他们更新游戏的能力，判断得彻头彻尾地错了。他们这次做出了很不一般的东西，我只想站出来承认自己错了，给他们应得的赞美。现在，我对这款游戏的未来无比期待。」

paragraphs.en: While not everyone is willing to go as far as to call it an all-time great video game update, it's hard to find anyone being too critical of what Embark had to offer. Pendola Pass' size seems to be an especially notable bright spot, with others mentioning the new UFO-style Arc ship known as the Frigate as another big highlight.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然不是所有人都愿意将其称为电子游戏史上最出色的更新之一，但也很难找到对Embark这次内容有太多不满的人。Pendola Pass的地图规模似乎尤其受到好评，也有人提到，名为Frigate的新型飞碟状Arc飞船是另一大亮点。

paragraphs.en: "Just played an hour before work, and I couldn't even explore more than 15% of the map," one player said . "There were so many things to check out and explore, this time they really delivered a big map!"
paragraphs.cn: 一位玩家表示：「上班前刚玩了一个小时，连地图的15%都没探索完。有太多东西可以看、可以探索，这次他们真的做出了一张大地图！」

paragraphs.en: "I agree, not to mention the new weapons, skills, weapons mods, it’s hard to believe they did all this in less than 6 months. Frigate is so damn cool," another said .
paragraphs.cn: 另一位玩家说：「我同意，更别说还有新武器、技能和武器配件。很难相信他们不到6个月就做出了这一切。Frigate实在太酷了。」

paragraphs.en: With such a drastic and sudden increase in attention, more highlight reels have started to find their way back to social media, too. New tools like the Grappling Hook come with obvious opportunities for shareable clips, as it allows Raiders to attach to everything from steep cliffs to flying Arc. Others can't help but draw comparisons to how the toy allows players to swing through maps like "Spider-Man."
paragraphs.cn: 随着关注度突然大幅攀升，社交媒体上也重新出现了更多精彩集锦。抓钩这样的新工具显然很适合制造值得分享的片段，因为突袭者可以用它钩住陡峭的悬崖，甚至是飞行中的Arc。还有人忍不住将其与「蜘蛛侠」相比，因为这个新玩具能让玩家在地图中荡来荡去。

paragraphs.en: "I was going to get that," one fan said , referring to a new wall-running skill, "but then I remembered grappling hooks exist now. It's sooo much more fun to swing around like Spider-Man and then run around at 100mph with no stamina usage."
paragraphs.cn: 一位玩家谈到新的蹬墙跑技能时说：「我本来打算点那个，但后来想起来，现在已经有抓钩了。像蜘蛛侠一样荡来荡去，再以每小时100英里（约161公里）的速度到处跑，还不消耗体力，实在好玩太多了。」

paragraphs.en: There's also the new Advanced Camera. It works exactly how you'd expect, giving players the tech to capture memories, all with the click of a button. Considering Arc Raiders has thrived on the comedy presented by its in-game systems, a camera has really only given that chaos another chance to shine.
paragraphs.cn: 更新还加入了高级相机（Advanced Camera）。它的功能和你想的一样，让玩家只需按一下按钮，就能记录值得留念的瞬间。《Arc Raiders》的游戏系统制造了不少喜剧场面，也为游戏积累了人气，而相机恰好又给这些混乱场面提供了一个大放异彩的机会。

paragraphs.en: Arc Raiders is having a bit of a moment, but we'll have to see if it has truly managed to recapture the magic that made it such a hit at launch. Up next is testing for a dedicated PvE mode , something fans have begged to see implemented since launch. Embark is certainly at least trying, with the game also available for 50% off on all platforms as players flock to its free weekend.
paragraphs.cn: 《Arc Raiders》眼下正迎来一波热度，但它是否真正找回了发售时让自己大获成功的魅力，还有待观察。接下来，游戏将测试专属PvE模式，这是玩家自发售以来就一直呼吁加入的内容。至少Embark确实在努力：玩家纷纷涌入免费周末的同时，游戏也在所有平台开启了五折优惠。

paragraphs.en: IGN gave Arc Raiders a 9/10 review when it arrived almost exactly one year ago, saying, "With polished gunplay and an irresistible grind, Arc Raiders sets a new standard for extraction shooters." Even if Embark can't entertain a consistently high number of players, it's clear the studio has more plans for the IP in the future. Both it and the studio's game-show-inspired FPS, The Finals, are set to receive TV show and movie adaptations at some point in the future .
paragraphs.cn: 《Arc Raiders》在几乎整整一年前推出时，IGN给出了9分评价，称：「凭借打磨出色的枪战体验，以及让人欲罢不能的刷取循环，《Arc Raiders》为撤离射击游戏树立了新的标杆。」即便Embark无法持续留住大量玩家，显然工作室仍为这个IP安排了更多未来计划。本作与工作室旗下受电视竞赛节目启发的第一人称射击游戏《The Finals》，未来都将推出电视剧和电影改编作品。

paragraphs.en: Frozen Trail brought more new content to Arc Raiders than we could list. You can see the full patch notes below.
paragraphs.cn: Frozen Trail为《Arc Raiders》带来的新内容多得难以一一列举。以下是完整更新说明。

paragraphs.en: The cold has arrived, and it's brought a lot with it. Frozen Trail is our biggest update since launch, packed with new features, fresh challenges, and a long list of fixes and improvements.
paragraphs.cn: 寒冷已经到来，也带来了丰富的内容。Frozen Trail是我们自游戏发售以来规模最大的一次更新，包含新功能、新挑战，以及大量修复和改进。

paragraphs.en: We've been working on this one for a while, and we couldn't be more excited to finally put it in your hands. Whether you're here for the new content or just want to know what we've fixed, there's something for everyone. Grab something warm, settle in, and read on for the full breakdown.
paragraphs.cn: 我们已经为这次更新忙碌了好一阵，如今终于能将它交到大家手中，我们无比兴奋。无论你是冲着新内容而来，还是只想了解我们修复了哪些问题，都能在这里找到自己关心的东西。拿点暖和的东西，舒服地坐好，继续阅读完整介绍吧。

paragraphs.en: Thank you for playing, for reporting bugs, and for sticking with us.
paragraphs.cn: 感谢大家游玩、反馈问题，也感谢大家一直与我们同行。

paragraphs.en: Changes to the Raider Skill Tree include new skills and improvements to existing skills, enabling players to better embellish their playstyle with more impactful skill choices.
paragraphs.cn: 突袭者技能树的改动包括加入新技能，以及改进现有技能。玩家可以选择作用更显著的技能，更好地完善自己的玩法风格。

paragraphs.en: We've heard the comments (and seen in the data) that the Skill Tree was not living up to its role in offering sufficiently interesting ways of building your character to better define and refine your playstyle. The goal of the Skill Tree revamp is twofold: to look at under-performing skills, modify or replace them, and to get closer to the goal of making choice and expression a more core feature of the Skill Tree.
paragraphs.cn: 我们收到了玩家的反馈，数据也反映了同样的问题：技能树没有发挥应有的作用，未能提供足够有趣的角色构筑方式，让玩家更好地确立并完善自己的玩法风格。这次技能树重做有两个目标：一是审视表现不佳的技能，修改或替换它们；二是进一步让玩家的选择与个性表达成为技能树更核心的部分。

paragraphs.en: Alongside some new skills and a reshuffling of the layout, new functionality has been added to replace the previous 'large' nodes at the middle and end of the branches. Now, for the middle of each branch, instead of having two selectable skills and two 'paths', there is one path where the node is a binary choice between two skills. You can only choose one; you will be able to make the choice again when you reset your skill tree. At the end of each branch are two nodes where you must make a choice out of three skills. Here, you can choose up to two of the three, after reaching the required skill point investment.
paragraphs.cn: 除了加入一些新技能并调整布局，我们还新增了功能，取代分支中段和末端原有的「大型」节点。现在，每条分支的中段不再提供两项可选技能和两条「路径」，而是只有一条路径，并在节点处让玩家从两项技能中二选一。你只能选择其中一项，重置技能树后可以重新选择。每条分支的末端则设有两个节点，需要从三项技能中作出选择。投入的技能点达到要求后，你最多可以选择这三项技能中的两项。

paragraphs.en: As this is a fairly big reimagining of the Skill Tree, there will likely be more tweaks and updates in the near future, to existing and new skills, as we see how you are engaging with it.
paragraphs.cn: 这次对技能树的重新设计幅度相当大，因此我们会观察大家的使用情况，并可能在近期继续调整和更新现有技能与新技能。

paragraphs.en: The Frozen Trail update introduces Weapon Stencils, a new cosmetic option that lets players personalize the look of their weapons with a range of stencil patterns. Note that stenciled weapons can still be lost like any other weapon: if you're downed, other Raiders can loot your weapon along with its stencil.
paragraphs.cn: Frozen Trail更新加入了武器喷绘模板（Weapon Stencils），这是一种新的外观自定义方式，让玩家可以用各种模板图案装饰武器。请注意，带有喷绘的武器仍会像其他武器一样丢失：如果你被击倒，其他突袭者可以将你的武器连同喷绘一起搜刮走。

paragraphs.en: Stencils are similar to blueprints, once learned you can apply them to compatible weapons. Applying Stencils requires Stencil Parts, which can be found Topside.
paragraphs.cn: 喷绘模板与蓝图类似，学会后即可用于兼容的武器。应用喷绘需要消耗喷绘零件（Stencil Parts），这些零件可在地表（Topside）找到。

paragraphs.en: New Outpost can be unlocked by completing a project.
paragraphs.cn: 完成一个项目即可解锁新的前哨站（Outpost）。

paragraphs.en: Similar to blueprints, they can be learned and used to craft different furniture for your Outpost.
paragraphs.cn: 与蓝图类似，学习后即可用它们为前哨站制作不同的家具。

paragraphs.en: The Reward Pass is our new progression system and the evolution of Raider Decks. Alongside this change, Cred has been removed from the game and replaced by Reward Points, a new currency that's automatically applied toward your progress on whichever pass you currently have active.
paragraphs.cn: 奖励通行证（Reward Pass）是我们新的成长系统，由突袭者卡组（Raider Decks）演变而来。伴随这次调整，Cred已从游戏中移除，由新货币奖励点数（Reward Points）取代。奖励点数会自动计入你当前启用的通行证进度。

paragraphs.en: The first new pass is the Frozen Trail Pass, featuring 60 levels across a Free and a Premium track.
paragraphs.cn: 首个新通行证是Frozen Trail通行证，共有60级，分为免费和高级两条奖励路线。

paragraphs.en: Your existing Raider Decks haven't gone anywhere. They've been moved into the new Legacy Pass, and any rewards you've already unlocked are kept and will appear as granted. You can continue progressing through the Legacy Pass at any time by setting it as your active pass. Note that only one Reward Pass can be active at a time, so your Reward Points will go toward whichever pass you've selected.
paragraphs.cn: 你已有的突袭者卡组并未消失。它们已转移至新的传承通行证（Legacy Pass），此前解锁的所有奖励都会保留，并显示为已发放。你随时可以将传承通行证设为当前启用的通行证，继续推进其进度。请注意，同一时间只能启用一个奖励通行证，因此奖励点数会计入你所选的通行证。

paragraphs.en: Feats are now split into 3 different categories: Easy, Medium and Hard.
paragraphs.cn: 功绩（Feats）现在分为三个类别：简单、中等和困难。

paragraphs.en: Weekly milestones are granting 250 Reward Points each, there are 3 of them available per week:
paragraphs.cn: 每个每周里程碑可提供250奖励点数，每周共有三个：

paragraphs.en: After completing your weekly milestones, you can keep completing Feats, but no major milestone rewards will be granted until the weekly timer is reset.
paragraphs.cn: 完成每周里程碑后，你仍可继续完成功绩，但在每周计时重置前，不会再获得主要里程碑奖励。

paragraphs.en: You can grab some new backpack attachments by watching your favorite streamer play ARC Raiders! You’ll need to watch at least 60 minutes to receive the Oxygen Respirator, and 120 minutes for the Mailbox. These drops will be live between October 8 - November 4, 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 观看你喜欢的主播游玩《Arc Raiders》，即可获得一些新的背包挂件！观看至少60分钟可获得氧气呼吸器（Oxygen Respirator），观看120分钟可获得邮箱（Mailbox）。此次掉宝活动将于2026年10月8日至11月4日开放。

paragraphs.en: We have recently begun taking further action to restrict accounts that store high amounts of duplicated items and remove items that were obtained through duplication from player inventories. This is done to help correct the in-game economy and clean up items that have appeared through past exploits.
paragraphs.cn: 我们近期已开始采取进一步措施，限制囤积大量复制物品的账号，并从玩家库存中移除通过复制获取的物品。此举旨在帮助恢复游戏内经济秩序，并清理此前利用漏洞产生的物品。
